# seq

Print numeric sequences for MoonX.

```sh
moonx cli/seq@0.2.6 [-w] [-f FORMAT] [-s STRING] [FIRST [INCREMENT]] LAST
```

## Supported scope

Accept LAST, FIRST LAST or FIRST INCREMENT LAST. Default increment is +1; use a negative increment to count down.

## Options

<!-- BEGIN GENERATED OPTIONS -->
<!-- Generated by tools/metadata from options.json. -->

| Option | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `-s` / `--separator` | required | Replace the separator between values. |
| `-w` / `--equal-width` | none | Pad values to equal width. |
| `-f` / `--format` | required | Use one e/E/f/F/g/G/a/A conversion. |
| `--help` | none | Show help / package version. |
| `--version` | none | Show help / package version. |
<!-- END GENERATED OPTIONS -->

## Limitations

- -f conflicts with -w and rejects dynamic *, integer or multiple conversions.
- Unformatted operands allow at most 4096 characters and exponent/scale within -4096..4096. Formatted numbers use the GNU Linux amd64 profile.

## Examples

```sh
moonx cli/seq@0.2.6 1 5
moonx cli/seq@0.2.6 3 -1 1
```
